author: Animan
description:
Top 10 anime that completely change after episode 1. These anime look harmless, cute, or generic… until episode 1 hits you with a shocking twist.

In this video, we’re breaking down anime that pull the ultimate bait-and-switch. From psychological ambushes like The Promised Neverland to emotional devastation in Made in Abyss, these shows completely flip the script in their very first episode.

Some start as wholesome slice-of-life.
Some look like generic shonen.
Some feel slow and harmless.

And then episode 1 rewrites EVERYTHING.
